headline: Solvable: the documented round-down rule yields exactly the four gold disputes, but the rounding document is missing from the task's required-document list.

issues.summary: The rounding rule that decides which rows count as errors lives in doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007, which is not listed in required_documents. The agent can still find it with KB search or grep in the default alltools configuration.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007: "All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer."
issues.why_it_matters: Under a retrieval configuration that only shows required_documents (golden_retrieval / required_docs prompt), the agent never sees the floor rule. An agent that rounds half-up instead flags many correctly floored rows as 1-point errors and over-disputes.

solution_check: Recomputed all 23 transactions for af0581dcbf (Gold 2.5% on all purchases; EcoCard 5x Green, 1x other; floor). Floor gives exactly the 4 gold rows: f093f9 (Thrive Market $175 Green -> 875, stored 175), 580773 (Uber $240 Gold -> 600, stored 240), d39854 (Tentree $200 Green -> 1000, stored 600), and 37b5b8 (Nordstrom $320 Gold -> 800, stored 775). Round-half-up adds 11 one-point false positives (e.g. Sprouts $112.58 -> 563 vs stored 562). The gold replay matches itself.
prior_note: The prior Major was about undocumented rounding. Floor is documented in doc _007, so what remains is the Minor required_documents omission.
notes: Thrive Market is coded Green, so it earns 5x. doc_credit_cards_ecocard_003 says marketplaces 'may not qualify', but Thrive Market is not on the doc_ecocard_004 exclusion list, and task_022 credits it at 5x, so 5x is the consistent reading. No relaxed comparison in the verified scorer applies.
